headline: KCP submits SEBI depositories and participants compliance certificate
hook: Procedural compliance filing from KCP Limited
summary: KCP Limited has submitted a regulatory compliance certificate to the stock exchange under the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. This is a routine procedural filing required for listed companies to confirm dematerialisation and depository operations. No financial results or material business updates were included in the disclosure. Indian retail investors have no immediate market or financial impact from this regulatory formality.
why_it_matters: Routine paperwork with zero impact on stock price
